quote: Unless the fragments are either completely detached or but slightly adherent, they should not be taken away, but should be replaced with care — as, in time, consolidation may take place, and very little permanent deformity will be left. source.part: Chapter XII, Wounds and Complications, Shot Wounds, Table CXVII (shot wounds of the spine, chest, abdomen, pelvis and back)

quote: Penetrations, extent not determined - -.------- 2,599 186 | 2, 226 187 92, 2

data.population: shot wounds of the abdomen by class (Table CXVII, 8,438 cases)
data.measure: percentage of fatality printed in Table CXVII

notes: Numbers compared with the page image of this table in the second issue (PDF page 775, printed page 689; crops p689-abd-crop-0775.png and p689-spine-chest-crop-0775.png). The OCR prints 92, 2 for 92.2. The row adds up (186 + 2,226 + 187 = 2,599). The printed percentage equals deaths divided by recoveries plus deaths.
